# Timoni Redis base

Seven Kubernetes objects built from an immutable Timoni module, with its master-first apply order kept beside the objects.

Start here when you open this Space in Hub. This page explains the problem this example is meant to show, what to inspect, why it matters, and where the evidence lives.

## Why this example exists

A typed module produces Kubernetes objects, but the objects alone do not explain the source choice or the order in which the module normally applies them.

This example keeps the source, exact objects, and lifecycle work together without treating the Timoni module OCI and the configuration OCI as the same artifact.

## What this example shows

- The Timoni module version, module digest, typed configuration, and selected values are recorded before materialization.
- The seven exact Kubernetes objects are available in a separate public configuration OCI.
- ConfigHub stores the same seven objects and records the configuration OCI digest on the Space.
- The master-first wait, replica ordering, optional PING test, namespace, Kubernetes version, and StorageClass remain explicit lifecycle work.

## Where each setting comes from

| Place | What this Space records |
| --- | --- |
| Starting configuration | The source record pins Timoni Redis 8.10.1 by module digest and records the selected default values and typed schema. |
| ConfigHub changes | The base imports the seven materialized objects without changing a field. Later ConfigHub revisions must remain distinct from the Timoni source selection. |
| Install work | Create the `redis` namespace, provide Kubernetes 1.20 or newer and the `standard` StorageClass, apply the master objects first, wait for the master, then apply the read-only replica. The PING test remains optional and disabled by default. |
| Live cluster | No destination is selected for this base, so the lifecycle work, admission, readiness, PING, upgrade, and rollback have not run. |

If an upstream change and a local ConfigHub revision touch the same field, review the overlap before promotion.

## Limits

- Publication and ConfigHub import are proved. Kubernetes apply, Argo CD, Flux, workload health, upgrade, and rollback are not run.
- The public artifact is digest-pinned but is not claimed to have a provenance signature.
